$comment: Findings accepted by npm run test:i18n-layout (scripts/e2e/i18n-layout.e2e.ts). Each entry of `allow` needs a non-empty `reason` and accepts every finding that matches ALL of its other fields: `locale` (code, or "*"), `screen` (exact, e.g. "popup/settings-sync", or prefix ending with *, e.g. "panel-320/*"), `kind` (truncated, clipped, spill, overflow, offscreen, placeholder, scroll), `key` (one of the finding's catalog keys), `text` (substring of the finding's text). Example: { "locale": "de", "screen": "panel-320/*", "key": "panel.tab.agenda", "reason": "tab label ellipsized at 320 px, accepted" }. Entries that match nothing are listed as stale in the report.

allow.reason: Next-episode chip of a Watching row, truncated by design (full text in its tooltip) when it doesn't fit: only a 4-digit episode with no known total (One Piece: « Bölüm 1123: 4 gün sonra » next to « bölüm 1122 ») reaches the limit. Turkish has no abbreviation for « bölüm » and « gün » stays in full (docs/i18n/glossary/tr.md), so no shorter natural wording exists.
